faqs.question: when is the next home game
faqs.answer: Our next home match is on Saturday, August 10th vs Annan Athletic at New Central Park. Kick-off is 3:00 PM. Get your tickets now!

faqs.question: where do i buy tickets
faqs.answer: Tickets are available online at www.keltyhearts.co.uk/tickets or at the gate on match day. Adult tickets are £12, concessions £8, under-16s free with an adult.

faqs.question: what is the stadium address
faqs.answer: Kelty Hearts plays at New Central Park, Kelty, Fife, KY4 0FB. It's easily accessible by car or bus. Parking is free.

faqs.question: what time does the match kick off
faqs.answer: Our home matches typically kick off at 3:00 PM on Saturdays. Midweek fixtures vary—check the fixtures page for exact times.

faqs.question: can i bring my kids
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We're a family-friendly club. Kids under 16 get in free with a paying adult. We have family spaces in the ground.

faqs.question: what league are we in
faqs.answer: Kelty Hearts FC plays in the Scottish League Two, the fourth tier of Scottish football. We're proud to represent Fife!

faqs.question: how do i become a member
faqs.answer: You can join our supporters club! Membership costs £30/year and includes a newsletter, special events, and priority ticket access. Sign up at www.keltyhearts.co.uk/join

faqs.question: what food is available
faqs.answer: We have a cafe serving hot pies, burgers, hot dogs, and drinks. There's also a bar area. We aim to have something for everyone!

faqs.question: how do i get there by public transport
faqs.answer: The ground is served by local buses. The nearest train station is Kelty Station, about 10 minutes walk. Check Traveline Scotland for current routes.

faqs.question: can i book a group visit
faqs.answer: Yes! Groups of 10+ get a discount. Contact our office at info@keltyhearts.co.uk or call 01383 XXXXXX to arrange.
